cover.prompt: On the elevated flagstone platform within the Crown ring wall, bandit-2 in slate grey tunic and bandit-3 in saffron orange face each other in dynamic 3/4 profiles, executing the formal transfer of a carved wooden command baton; bandit-2 extends the staff horizontally with arms swung clear of his body, chest angled 35 degrees to the camera, while bandit-3 reaches forward in a broad contact stride, fingers open to receive it; a cyclopean stone pier forms the foreground anchor on the left margin; behind them the opposite curved parapet of the ring wall stands sharp and unyielding, backed by the empty sky and distant Aegean horizon, completely free of silhouette clutter.
